body:
Quoting @sokra on IRC:

> @cowwoc I may have an explanation... but still think it's related to the dedupe plugin (DP)...
> DP inserts deduplication code when modules are deduplicated. ETP replaces extracted modules with an empty module when extracted. In the first build there are no duplicate modules. In the second build the DP finds the empty modules from the ETP and flag them as duplcated (this means references to equal modules are inserted, a number as module instead of a function), but the entry chunk is not rewritten and deduplication code is missing...

@sokra Unfortunately, https://github.com/webpack/webpack/commit/13b60359f42980099c57ac7626d79dfa5b1efcea did not fix the problem for me. Please reopen this issue and I will provide some sort of testcase to it so you can reproduce this on your end.

issue.title: [optimize/webpack] remove dedupe plugin

repository.name: kibana
repository.description: Your window into all of your data

issue.body:
Issues similar to those described in webpack/webpack#770 seem to be causing issues in our builds as of late. As described in the issue, this is likely a conflict with the way that `DedupePlugin` interacts with `ExtractTextPlugin` and I just noticed that `DedupePlugin` is actually [marked experimental](http://webpack.github.io/docs/list-of-plugins.html#dedupeplugin).

Removing the plugin does not seem to have any effect, positive or negative, so I vote that we just remove it.
